title: Jakarta Running Festival 2026 Review: Indonesia's Multi-Day Marathon Festival
seo_title: Jakarta Running Festival 2026 Review | Indonesia Marathon Guide
meta_description: The Jakarta Running Festival 2026: October 22-25 in Jakarta. Full marathon, half, 10K, and 5K over four days — Indonesia's biggest multi-day running festival with registration open.
dek: Running 22-25 October 2026 in Jakarta, this is Indonesia's premier multi-day running festival — four distances across four days with the full marathon as the headliner. Registration open in late-bird tier. A rare full marathon in the Indonesian capital.
verdict: The Jakarta Running Festival is Indonesia's answer to the multi-day running festival model — four days (22-25 October 2026) with four distances (42K, 21K, 10K, 5K) spread across a long weekend in the capital. A full marathon in Jakarta is a genuinely rare proposition; most Indonesian marathons are in Bali, Jogja, or Borobudur. Registration is open in the late-bird tier, and the high reliability score of 88 reflects strong data confidence. For runners wanting a major Indonesian marathon with festival energy in the country's cosmopolitan capital, this is the pick.

sections.heading: Four Days, Four Distances
paragraphs: The multi-day format spreads four distances across a long weekend, reducing the single-day congestion of a traditional marathon and letting runners participate in multiple events.
